nodes.name: Evaluate Intake
nodes.notes: Same worker-level and company-level checks as onboarding.py. Keep in sync.

nodes.name: Human Review Queue
nodes.notes: Company-level flags or worker problems (wrong form, duplicate, unknown worker). Replace with Slack or Notion to post the flags.

nodes.name: Approval Queue (reminders)
nodes.notes: Drafts for workers with missing items. A human must approve before anything is sent. Do not connect a sending node without an approval step.

nodes.name: Ready Path
nodes.notes: Complete, clean intakes. Replace with a notification to ops.
